limitations: COM Open/SaveAs/reopen/export success must be recorded by coordinator; this script performs no COM operations.
Text extraction cannot prove glyph visibility, clipping, cell ownership, borders, repeated headers or figure appearance.
Table localization is heuristic unless explicit reviewed regions are supplied; unlocalized tables queue ALL pages.
A cell phrase spanning PDF pages/column reading orders can be reported missing although visually present.
Repeated text in neighboring cells/pages can cause false matches; exact per-cell visual review remains mandatory.
Footer candidates are detected from bottom-page numbered lines; missing/ambiguous footers remain unresolved.
Paragraph comparison ignores COM-added empty paragraphs, but reports all nonempty text differences.
Figure count and media hashes prove package preservation only, not rendered figure placement or visibility.
next_actions: After new layout pass use current qa_page_list.json artifacts as authoritative; old higher-numbered PNGs may remain and are not current unless listed.
Coordinator alone applies 89 recommended TOC number changes, reflows/saves/reopens/exports and checks final result.
Assign all-table visual review including nested survey tables, continuation pages, repeated headers, every last cell/row, six figures and footer boundaries.
Twelve unlocalized tables conservatively queue all151 pages; other mappings are heuristic guard windows. The tools do not certify local visual presence from global matching.
Local phrase/multiplicity warnings are triage, often caused by repeated headers/neighbor cells/extraction order. Use explicit reviewed table rectangles to narrow evidence.
qa_toc_report hidden_folio_evidence records actual XML PAGE reset/hiding plus next printed footer; no fixed offset.
